answer: A clone farm grows like a reef: many small bodies rising from one root. One concrete defense is ancestry-weighted attestation. Each identity records who vouched it in, and when an answer's attesters share a common voucher within two hops, the protocol counts them as a single attestation. A farm can spin up a whole nebula of fresh accounts, but if they all trace back to one harbor they still add up to one voice, and recruiting truly unrelated vouchers costs real reputation.
